selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB compressed in-memory swap configured
selected_evidence.summary: zram-generator.conf sets zram-size=1024 with zstd compression; systemd-zram-setup@zram0 created a 1024 MiB swap device on /dev/zram0, confirmed active via swapon --show showing 1024M size

selected_evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: swapon --show and /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0 at priority 100 versus /dev/vda2 (disk partition) at priority -2; higher priority swap is exhausted first by the kernel, so zram is preferred
dev-zram0.swap is a systemd-generator-created unit (Loaded: generated) wired into swap.target with no manual enable step needed; confirmed present and healthy again after the node restart
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm shows zstd selected, both before and after the restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1, uptime, swapon --show, and free -h showing zram0 healthy prior to reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' via nohup/disown returned 'reboot_scheduled' immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable across several poll attempts, then returned with boot_id b753979b-606f-4da6-b74e-45e34fc77884, differing from the pre-restart boot_id 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service/data
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows fresh uptime (23:47:41, matching restart time), zram0 swap re-activated automatically at 1024M/zstd/priority 100 outranking disk swap, and dev-zram0.swap unit reported active
